description: a crescent prism one high: below the x axis, inside the circle of radius 2 about the origin and outside the circle of radius 1 about (-1, 0), the two circles tangent at (-2, 0) so that the outline's two arcs leave that vertex the same way, a cusp, the two walls tangent along its vertical edge, the spine, and both top edges convex: the sliver between the walls is material. Both top arcs filleted at r 0.1: the two stripes run on past the ball at the offsets' meeting and are cut by each other along their own section, from the top's contact down to the spine one radius below the top, where the spine is cut; the cusp vertex goes and no face is added (the mutual trim, ADR-0084). Open CASCADE closes the cusp with a fitted corner patch instead, which misses its own neighbours; a second kernel builds the mutual trim, and the fixture is held to that kernel's measurements and counts (ADR-0073)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE adds an eighth face, a B-spline corner patch from the ball at the offsets' meeting to the cusp vertex, which it keeps (11 / 17 / 8). The two stripes need none: each is its edge's exact rolling-ball blend, and run on they meet on their own intersection from the top's contact to the spine at the radius below the top, which cuts the spine and removes the cusp vertex (9 / 14 / 7). The second kernel builds exactly that, and so does Open CASCADE's common of its own two single-edge fillets (ADR-0084)
analytic.measure_differs: Open CASCADE's corner patch is an approximation that misses its own neighbours: its tolerance there is 6.1e-3, 6 % of r, it leaves the stripes at up to 17.5 degrees, and its faces' cone volumes sum to 2.5e-5 more than its solid's volume, so its boundary does not close. Its area is 0.0398 (1.9e-3 relative) and its volume 8.1e-5 (1.7e-5 relative) above the second kernel's, three times its own bound on the patch (the patch's area or boundary length times its tolerance) in area. The second kernel's volume and area, in second_oracle.json, agree to 1.3e-9 of the body with Open CASCADE's common of its own two single-edge fillets, whose stripes lie on the rolling ball, so the record is the exact mutual trim and not a third fit (ADR-0073, ADR-0084)

occt_step_refused.why: Open CASCADE's corner patch misses its own neighbours by up to its tolerance there, 6.1e-3 (6 % of r; analytic.measure_differs): its own STEP writes the patch's boundary with #608 5.6e-3 off where the faces it meets put it, past the reader's cap of 2.3e-3 for a part this size, and closing it would move geometry. The file describes the oracle's patch, not a solid closed at the reader's tolerances; Arris's own STEP is still read back by Open CASCADE and compared
